_doc: Religious calendar (owner-editable in /manage/ → Religious calendar; the private store copy is authoritative after first import). Ramadan = ADVISORY ONLY (never blocks, never closes, booking stays allowed). Eid = five-day operating block for STANDARD SCHEDULED departures: the day before Eid, Eid day, and the three days after (days_before/days_after). Any overlap of a departure's full inclusive range counts. state: estimated | confirmed — estimated dates are always shown as 'expected', never as final.

ramadan.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 1 Ramadan 1448 ≈ Mon 8 Feb 2027; last day ≈ Mon 8 Mar 2027). Local moon sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/ when announced.

eid_al_fitr.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 1 Shawwal 1448 ≈ Tue 9 Mar 2027). Local sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/.

eid_al_adha.source: Astronomical estimate (Umm al-Qura: 10 Dhu al-Hijjah 1448 ≈ Sun 16 May 2027). Local sighting may shift ±1 day — confirm in /manage/.
